free_tier.stated: 'Мы дарим 150 мб тестового трафика на все файлообменники' on the home page; a second block on the same page says 'Зарегистрируйтесь и получите 100 MB тестового трафика'. No recurring free allowance.
free_tier.notes: The two trial figures are both on the home page (150 MB in one block, 100 MB in another).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: it forwards a link to the source host; no maximum file size published on the pages that would render

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage is sold, only the download of a link that already exists at the source host

egress.terms: Speed is described as a floor, not a ceiling: 'Мы предоставим высокую скорость скачивания, свыше 1 МБ/сек.' Traffic is bought in GB.

interface_detail: Web form: paste a link, the service fetches it. 'Загрузка в один клик'. No API, CLI or mount is documented on the pages read.
tooling: Browser only as documented. The output is a download served by transload.me, so a download manager can take it, but nothing is published about link lifetime or resume.
chaining: A cheap per-GB top-up for the handful of hosts a seedbox cannot reach; not a substitute for a full debrid because the host list is 28 names and the speed floor is 1 MB/s.

limits.value: download speed stated as 'свыше 1 МБ/сек' (above 1 MB/s), no upper bound published

limits_note: 28 hosts are named in the service picker (1fichier, ddownload, elfile, elitefile, emload, file.al, fileaxa, fileboom, filedot, filextras, gigapeta, hitfile, isra.cloud, jumploads, katfile, keep2share, kshared, mega.nz, nitroflare, prefiles, rapidgator, rg.to, terabytez, tezfiles, turbobit, upstore, wdupload, world-files). The marketing block still lists 18-20 legacy hosts including Uploaded and Letitbit.
binding_note: At 1 TiB a month the 1 MB/s floor is the constraint that decides: 1 MB/s sustained is about 2.6 TB/month, so a full 1 TiB month is reachable only if the floor is the real rate for the whole month. The GB balance is the second constraint and is prepaid.

identity_cost.detail: 'Регистрация займёт всего 10 секунд'; the register page asks for an account, and the trial traffic is attached to it.

reliability_note: The price page returns an empty body to every reader tried (three paths: /ru/?p=tariffs, /ru/?p=price, /ru/?p=price&t=1), so the tariff can only be learned after login; a 2024 group-buy thread states the price moves with the euro rate.
confidence_note: The host list, the trial size and the 1 MB/s floor are documented from the live page. The price is a third-party group-buy post from 2024-12-29 and the vendor's own price page could not be rendered, so the record is reported. Logging in and reading the tariff would raise it to documented. Evidence dates normalised to the read date on 2026-10-23; a source that carries its own date keeps it in the proved field.

evidence.proved: the host list, '20 файл-хостов в одном аккаунте', the 100-150 MB trial, and 'свыше 1 МБ/сек'
third-party price: 'от ~4.40 руб за 1 ГБ. ~ 44 руб. за 10ГБ трафика на 24 файлообменника. (Цена зависит от курса евро.)' and a 10 GB minimum
the vendor price page answers 200 with a zero-length body and cannot be read without a session; recorded as the failed route, not as a price

price_per_tb_month: RUB 4400 per TB at the 2024-12-29 reported rate (RUB 4.40/GB), unverified for 2026
notes: One of very few RU-language multi-hosters still answering in 2026. The caveat is the price: the vendor hides it behind login and the only public figure is 20 months old. The 1 MB/s floor is the number to judge it by, not the host count.
